question: The wetland protection organization needs to manage multiple wetland protection areas. Each protection area has an ID, name, location, and person in charge. The system shall record the species, quantity, and growth status of flora and fauna in each protection area. Each record shall include the recording time, recording personnel, species, and quantity of flora and fauna. The system also needs to record environmental changes within the protection areas, including temperature, humidity, rainfall, etc., and specify the time and location of the changes. The system can automatically record environmental changes through sensors, and there is no need to store recorder information here.
ddl:
-- Schema for database: rschema_0485

CREATE TABLE wetland_protection_areas (
  id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  location VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  person_in_charge VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE TABLE flora_and_fauna (
  id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  recording_time DATETIME NOT NULL,
  recording_personnel VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  species VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  quantity INT(11) NOT NULL,
  growth_status VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  wetland_protection_area_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (wetland_protection_area_id) REFERENCES wetland_protection_areas(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE environmental_changes (
  id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  time DATETIME NOT NULL,
  location VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  temperature FLOAT NOT NULL,
  humidity FLOAT NOT NULL,
  rainfall FLOAT NOT NULL,
  wetland_protection_area_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (wetland_protection_area_id) REFERENCES wetland_protection_areas(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);
